mood: Hurt and alone in a ring of enemies, she says she will bear it all, and means every word.

hero.alt: Vexana stands alone on a ruined platform under a storm sky, her staff raised and a crown of violet blades behind her head, tall gray Enders all around her.

thumb.alt: Tall gray Enders with clawed arms and yellow eyes stalk across a ruined city under a storm sky.

media.alt: Close on Vexana's face in the fight, a bruise on her cheek, her violet eye narrowed and hard.
Vexana fights the Enders alone across the ruined platform, firing her staff from the ground, leaping and striking; then bursts of violet light break around her as she fires into them.
A vast dark armored shape towers against violet light and storm cloud, its crowned head high in the glare, huge clawed wings spread wide and its chest shut.
Through violet smoke a ring of magenta light swells in the sky above Vexana; then she is hurled backward and lies small among the broken stone of the ruined city.
